peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (58.7): 3.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 229 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Dakota MRT about 680 m, Paya Lebar MRT about 810 m; closer than 152 of 662 similar developments (the same as 9). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Tanjong Katong Primary School about 750 m; more than 547 of 662 similar developments (the same as 73). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 440 m), more than 281 of 662 similar developments (the same as 80); nearest hawker centre Haig Road Market And Cooked Food Centre about 570 m; nearest park Wilkinson Interim Park about 1,220 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Haig Road Market And Cooked Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 40 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 510 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 520 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 590 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 650 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 940 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 1,060 m; Amber House, 31 new sales, about 1,100 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 477 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 476 new sales and 1,032 resales (1,508 purchases); new sales were 31.6% of these purchases. Subsales (42) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,032 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 622 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,032 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,204 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.3%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
